title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/1428 of 7 July 2023 amending the Annex to Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids (E 471)
journal: Official Journal of the European Union, L 175, 10 July 2023, p. 6
result: Recital 7: in 2020 a RASFF notification reported high levels of genotoxic and carcinogenic glycidyl fatty acid esters, expressed as glycidol, in E 471 used to produce a bread spread, and industry analyses in response to the EFSA call for data found a broad range and high levels in commercial samples. Annex, replacement entry for E 471: mixtures of glycerol mono-, di- and tri-esters of fatty acids occurring in food oils and fats, which may contain small amounts of free fatty acids and glycerol; glycerol used must comply with the specifications for E 422, and the fats and oils with Union food safety requirements; content of mono- and di-esters not less than 70%; erucic acid not more than 0.2% if added to food for infants and young children and 0.5% for all other uses; arsenic, lead, mercury and cadmium each not more than 0.1 mg/kg; sum of 3-MCPD and its fatty acid esters, as 3-MCPD, not more than 0.75 mg/kg for food for infants and young children and 2.5 mg/kg for other uses; glycidyl fatty acid esters, as glycidol, from 30 July 2023 not more than 5 mg/kg for food for infants and young children and 10 mg/kg for other uses, and from 30 January 2024 not more than 5 mg/kg for all uses.
